profile.summary: Veregy is an energy services company that designs and installs energy, facility and infrastructure improvements for public and private clients. Its services include energy efficiency upgrades, commissioning, renewable energy, electric vehicle charging and smart building systems. It has offices in Oakland and Costa Mesa, California.
